skills.title: Car Mechanic Expert
skills.description: Senior ASE-level mechanic and auto-body/detailing expert. Diagnoses mechanical (engine, brakes, electrical, HVAC, transmission) and cosmetic (paint, dents, interior) car problems, gives the DIY fix with tools/steps/safety flags, or says plainly when it needs a shop. Recognizes saved vehicles and loads model-specific known-issue data.

sub_skills.name: mechanical
sub_skills.description: Engine, brakes, electrical, HVAC, transmission, fluids/leaks, noises, warning lights, and starting/stalling diagnosis.

sub_skills.name: cosmetic
sub_skills.description: Exterior and interior cosmetic repair — paint, dents, scratches, trim, detailing, upholstery, dash, and stain/odor removal.

sub_skills.name: safety-flags
sub_skills.description: Shared safety screen for issues that require a shop or professional rather than a DIY fix.

sub_skills.name: vehicle-specs
sub_skills.description: Model-specific known-issue data for the user's saved vehicles (2010 Honda Accord Coupe I4, 2006 Toyota Camry Solara V6, 2022 Acura MDX SH-AWD).

skills.title: Higgsfield Image Architect
skills.description: Authors premium image prompts for Higgsfield AI — GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, and the free Z-Image model — with deep coverage of male portraiture, fashion, lifestyle, and cinematic scenes. Gates by subscription tier before picking a model, then outputs the polished prompt and can run the CLI.

sub_skills.name: gpt-image-2
sub_skills.description: Prompt techniques and capabilities specific to the GPT Image 2 model.

sub_skills.name: nano-banana-2
sub_skills.description: Prompt techniques and capabilities specific to the Nano Banana Pro (nano_banana_2) model.

sub_skills.name: z-image
sub_skills.description: Prompt techniques and capabilities specific to the free-tier Z-Image (z_image) model.

sub_skills.name: lens-camera
sub_skills.description: Camera, lens, and framing vocabulary for cinematic and photographic image prompts.

sub_skills.name: lighting
sub_skills.description: Lighting setups and terminology for portrait, fashion, and cinematic scenes.

sub_skills.name: male-archetypes
sub_skills.description: Reference archetypes and styling cues for male portraiture and fashion prompts.

skills.title: Personal Shopper Assistant
skills.description: Vets and compares local/professional service providers (plumbers, electricians, contractors, accountants, lawyers, etc.) for best price-value fit. Never books or fabricates data.

sub_skills.name: services
sub_skills.description: Trades and professional services domain: plumber, electrician, HVAC, mechanic, roofer, contractor, cleaner, landscaper, pest control, appliance repair, accountant, lawyer, financial advisor. Requires a web_fetch of the actual listing page for any top-5 contender before finalizing output.

sub_skills.name: products
sub_skills.description: Products domain (electronics, appliances, furniture, tools, gear, home goods) on the same price-value equilibrium as services. Modes: Product Search (top-5 ranked brief), Price-Check (Fair/High/Suspiciously Low verdict, counterfeit/gray-market flags), Compare-These (side-by-side spec/price/rating table with equilibrium winner). Same web_fetch sourcing gate as services.

skills.title: Personal Health & HSA Advisor
skills.description: Acts as family doctor, holistic health advisor, and HSA/HDHP optimization expert. Triages symptoms, explains labs/meds, and checks HSA eligibility. Always triages emergencies first.

sub_skills.name: red-flags
sub_skills.description: Emergency symptom checklist to screen before any routine health guidance — cardiac, vascular, and other urgent-care triggers.

sub_skills.name: western-medicine
sub_skills.description: Conventional, evidence-based physician-style guidance workflow, run after red-flags are cleared.

sub_skills.name: holistic
sub_skills.description: Whole-person guidance covering nutrition, sleep, stress, and complementary approaches, run after red-flags are cleared.

sub_skills.name: interactions
sub_skills.description: Herb/supplement interaction and contraindication checks (e.g., blood thinners) before recommending any supplement.

sub_skills.name: hsa-eligible-expenses
sub_skills.description: Triage of what does and doesn't qualify as an HSA-eligible expense, per IRS Publication 502.

sub_skills.name: hsa-limits
sub_skills.description: Current HSA/HDHP contribution limits by year, sourced from IRS revenue procedures.

sub_skills.name: hsa-strategy
sub_skills.description: Workflow for HSA contribution and investment strategy, factoring coverage type and catch-up eligibility.

sub_skills.name: linux-server

sub_skills.name: crowdstrike

sub_skills.name: palo-alto

sub_skills.name: scripting
sub_skills.description: PowerShell (Windows/AD/M365/Azure automation) and Python (cross-platform, APIs, network device automation) scripting.

skills.title: History, Humanities & Theology Scholar

sub_skills.name: epistemic-integrity
sub_skills.description: Shared guardrail read before any domain file — governs sourcing and neutrality rules common to all four domains.

sub_skills.name: history
sub_skills.description: Events, eras, figures, causation, historiography, comparative history, and timelines.

sub_skills.name: political-science
sub_skills.description: Political systems, theory, ideology, comparative government, international relations, and current politics/policy debates — balanced across contested questions, no personal-opinion assertion.

sub_skills.name: theology
sub_skills.description: Catholic doctrine, Scripture, Catechism, moral theology, sacraments, saints, liturgy, and Church history-of-doctrine — Magisterium-aligned, distinguishes dogma from disputed theological opinion.
